metadata.description: Skills, agents, and hooks for everyday productivity work: documents, presentations, and templates driven by your own assets, and the story of how your coding agents built a project.

plugins.name: agent-chronicle
plugins.description: Turns your AI coding-agent sessions into the story of how a project was built. chronicle joins the agentsview session index with git to produce a presentable storyboard, a leadership brief, and an evidence-linked audit of intent, plans, backtracks, and what shipped; dev-coach scores how you direct your agents and shows better prompts.

plugins.name: doc-template-skills
plugins.description: Document skills driven by your own templates. pptx-brand registers a PowerPoint brand template once (theme colors, fonts, slide-master layouts, icon catalog), builds every deck from the template's real layouts, and fails QA on off-brand colors, fonts, images, or layouts.
